videos.title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
videos.description: The Emergency Response Team have their hands full of a sadistic murderer who transforms the jail, a roller derby queen who takes a hard fall and one inmate who realizes that even a good day in jail can have a dark side.

videos.title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
videos.description: Using a form of integration at Indiana State that goes beyond race, the Residential Treatment Unit selects inmates with a history of good behavior to live with and serve as mentors to inmates with mental health issues.

videos.title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
videos.description: One inmate contends that a law could put him away forever; an inmate sentenced to life without parole prays that a new law will set him free.

videos.title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
videos.description: A massive search for contraband throughout the facility turns up the heat on two inmates inside the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution; a convict prompts an evacuation when he floods his housing unit.

videos.title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
videos.description: A violent gang member asks to move back to general population, following six years in segregation; a brother and sister are charged with murdering a high school football star, two years after he was stabbed to death on an Oakland street corner.

videos.title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
videos.description: Welcome to Limon Correctional Facility, a level 4 prison that houses many of Colorado's most dangerous inmates; while visiting Limon Correctional, the Lockup crew is greeted by angry inmates and the cell extraction team is called in to help.

videos.title: Lockup Special Investigation
videos.description: For some kids, the revolving door of lockup seems to snag one generation after the next; 17-year-old Kenneth and 14-year-old Kentrell have 10 brothers and sisters, a father in prison and a mother with a criminal record for public nuisance.

videos.title: Lockup Special Investigation
videos.description: More than three thousand kids pass through the juvenile courts in Lake County, Indiana each year; here, consequences can range from a sleepless night in detention to the ultimate punishment for kids who keep coming back: Boys' School.

videos.title: Lockup: Raw
videos.description: Three unforgettable inmates, each one about to cross the threshold to freedom; witness their joys, their fears, their triumphs and discover that sometimes the only thing tougher than being in prison, is staying out.

videos.title: Lockup: Raw
videos.description: For some, prison might be hell, and it can be even worse for the sex offenders.

videos.description: How gangs are managed in the jail system; how family relationships affect the jail experience.

videos.title: Lockup: Raw
videos.description: An exploration of first-time inmates that look like they should be sitting in classrooms rather than jail cells.

videos.title: Lockup: Raw
videos.description: The troublemakers of the jail system and how correctional officers control the situation caused by these troublemakers.

videos.title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
videos.description: Fontainebleau Miami Beach hotel heir Ben Novack Jr. is bludgeoned to death three months after his mother, Bernice, is found dead under suspicious circumstances; Novack's wife, Narcy, a former stripper, becomes the key to unlocking this sordid case.

videos.title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
videos.description: Wealthy suburbanite Jane Bashara is found strangled to death in a seedy part of Detroit known for drugs, crime and murder; a handyman is charged, but that's only the beginning of the story which is ultimately about sex, lies and betrayal.

videos.title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
videos.description: Living a golden life, entrepreneurs James and Pamela Fayed turn a fledgling coin company into a gold trading empire; after Pamela is brutally stabbed to death, her murder case reveals a federal fraud investigation and a marriage filled with lies.

videos.title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
videos.description: When a wealthy Texas retiree is found dead in a ravine in Mexico, all eyes turn to his young boyfriend, a porn actor; while investigators uncover the truth behind their relationship, border crossing records provide the key to solving the case.

videos.title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
videos.description: A serial imposter pretends to be an aristocrat and Rockefeller fortune heir; when bones are dug up behind a house in an affluent California community, police want to know who Clark Rockefeller really is.

videos.title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
videos.description: The body of a Chicago woman is found stuffed in a suitcase at a luxury resort in Bali; the murder of Sheila von Wiese-Mack is a tragedy years in the making, featuring a wild-child daughter, a history of violence, and a shocking motive.

videos.title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
videos.description: Toni Henthorn, M.D. is a brilliant surgeon and mother with a seemingly perfect home life; when a romantic getaway weekend turns tragic, is she the victim of an unfortunate accident or the target of a black-hearted master plan worth millions?

videos.title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
videos.description: When a Manhattan heiress vanishes from her mansion, friends, staff and investigators are mystified; the investigation leads to a mysterious tenant who moved into the mansion weeks earlier and a transcontinental story of deceit, arson and murder.

videos.title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
videos.description: Horror strikes the wealthy enclave of Aspen, Colo. when heiress Nancy Pfister is found brutally murdered in her mountain home; as police work to untangle a twisted web of suspects, a shocking confession puts a sudden end to the investigation.

videos.title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
